description: Bulk per-game player stat rows (game logs) filtered by player, team, or event — the model-training data feed. At least one of player_id / team_id / event_id is required. Each row is one player-game with the raw stat JSON. Paginate with cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` from a previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Max rows to return (page size). Default 50, server caps apply.

name: get_player_game_logs
